summary: Comprehensive frontend test of Alfred AI HUD/CHAT/DESIGN tabs, holographic Earth widget, and HoloMap modal. All features work as specified. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Wake-word setup error banner ('Wake-word setup failed: Requested device not found') is shown in CHAT tab even though no microphone is available in this preview environment (expected); consider hiding behind a 'request mic' affordance so it doesn't pollute the empty-chat state.

Spotify widget shows 'SPOTIFY · ERROR · SPOTIFY API 404: NOT FOUND' under the Earth hologram on the HUD — okay for mocked preview, but make the failure styling less prominent (it visually competes with the orb).
Console emits THREE.Clock deprecation warning and repeated 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' warnings from R3F — non-blocking but should be reviewed when bumping three.js.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 review checkpoints verified end-to-end via Playwright on the preview URL. Notes: (1) HUD tab renders TitleBlock (ALFRED · RESIDENT BUTLER · V1) with all 4 corner notches (testids title-block-notch-tl/tr/bl/br), GreetingCard 'At your service, sir.', SystemStatus pill with 6 rows (system/wake/voice/camera/hands/memory), OperationsLog with 2 timestamped rows (STANDBY + BOOT · system online), Orb3D, and EarthHologramWidget. (2) Earth widget header shows 'EARTH · HOLOGRAM', has EXPAND button, inside-canvas 'EARTH · LIVE' label, and bottom hint 'DRAG · ROTATE  PINCH · ZOOM  CLICK · DROP PIN'. holographic-earth canvas mounts after ~5s. (3) EXPAND opens HoloMapView modal with HOLOMAP title, search input, CLOSE button, Leaflet map div, +/- zoom controls — all confirmed. (4) Searching 'Tokyo' + Enter calls Nominatim and returns suggestion '東京都, 日本' inside [data-testid=holo-map-suggestions]; clicking it flies the map. (5) CLOSE button dismisses the modal and returns to HUD (earth-hologram-widget reappears). (6) CHAT tab: chat-tab-view renders with left rail tabs (chat/archives/memory), 'NEW CONVERSATION' button, 'No conversations yet' label; right pane shows 'Say "Hello Alfred" to begin.' centered with composer (mic + attach + textarea + SEND). No HUD widgets bleed through (earth/greeting/title-block/ops-log/system-status all count=0 in CHAT). (7) DESIGN tab still renders cad-studio + cad-toolbar + cad-properties + design-chat-overlay. (8) Tab switching HUD<->CHAT<->DESIGN works via data-testid clicks (force=True). Backend 404s for /api/chat, /api/spotify, /api/printer, etc. are mocked/expected. No camera/mic in preview so wake/voice/camera/hands status pills stay yellow/red — acceptable.
